concerns.text: FR-013 – The specification requires a documented discussion of the circularity limitation (parameter‑name copying) in the analysis report, but no task in tasks.md addresses adding this discussion.

FR-015 – The system must assign a coverage score of 0.0 for any method where `human_docstring` is `null` and include this in per‑method and per‑repository aggregates; no task explicitly implements or verifies this behavior.
FR-017 – A human‑evaluation sampling study (random subset Likert rating) is required, yet tasks.md contains no task that performs or validates this study.
SC-001 – The success criterion that Description Coverage ≥ 5 tokens per parameter for ≥ 80 % of methods is not linked to any task that computes or checks this threshold.
SC-004 – The pipeline’s computational feasibility (≤ 6 h runtime, ≤ 7 GB RAM) is not measured or validated by any task.
SC-005 – The same threshold as SC-001 (≥ 5 tokens per parameter for ≥ 80 % of methods) is missing a dedicated verification task.
SC-007 – The requirement that the human‑evaluation average Likert rating be ≥ 4.0 lacks any task to compute or assert this metric.
